Image size: 512 x 512
Choose how to provide secret data to embed:
1. Text message
2. Raw bit string (0s and 1s)
Enter choice (1 or 2): 1
Enter text message: Digital images are widely used in healthcare, military communication, scientific research, and information sharing. Protecting confidential information while preserving the original image is an important requirement. Reversible Data Hiding (RDH) enables secret data to be embedded into an image and extracted later while recovering the original image exactly. Prediction-based RDH uses neighboring pixels to estimate pixel values and calculate prediction errors. This project investigates adaptive distance-based pixel selection to improve prediction accuracy, embedding capacity, and image quality while maintaining exact image recovery.
